The trigger (WHEN event.on-win, which fires once per KO the holder scores) is a separate swappable block and the class has no condition of its own beyond the living-ally feasibility, which is the effect's target and stays in the class. Requests R-B15-9 (target 'my weakest ally') and R-B15-10 (atom 'KOs I scored this turn') would let it become WHEN + heal-percent + (IF kos >= 2) cure-status. Both numbers (heal share, KO number that starts the cure) are typed params. State: erCleansingLightKoState is read by the AI snapshot (ai/combat-private-state.ts), so the WeakMap stays as it is. Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) the KO counter only runs when canApply found a living ally, so a KO scored while no ally stands does not count toward 'second KO this turn' (and the `if (!ally)` branch after the bump can never be reached); (2) the status cure message is a hard-coded English string, not an i18n key; (3) the heal message reuses the 'postTurnHeal' text.

blocks.packageReason: Tier B, PACKAGE for the effect only. 1 attr in 1 ability: Dandelion Burst (5907 attr 0). The trigger (after taking damage), the crossing condition (hp.crossed-below, floor-half, ratio param linked by gateParams) and the not-fainted guard are separate blocks; the effect does two things per foe in one loop (plant Leech Seed with the source move Leech Seed, and a stat-stage phase). Why the effect is a package: effect.apply-tag is not implemented in the library, so the seeding cannot be an existing block; the stat half could be effect.stat-stage on the opposing side but the two are interleaved per foe in one loop and splitting them WOULD change phase order for several foes: SeedTag.onAdd calls phaseManager.queueMessage (not deferred, so it unshifts a MessagePhase), hence per foe the queue gets [seeded message, stat phase] and a split would get [all seeded messages, all stat phases]. This is PROVEN by a phase-order trace in test/tests/elite-redux/decomp/B15/chunk2.test.ts (two foes; the interleaved order differs from the split order). Once effect.apply-tag exists (R-B15-8) and a rule can run two effects per foe in the same loop, the stat drop becomes effect.stat-stage; until then stat and stages stay typed params of this package (see requests R-B15-8). The Leech Seed tag and its source move are fixed (the pair SEEDED + Leech Seed); stat and stages are typed params. LEGACY part: the once-per-battle memory (clause 2) is the ability's own WeakMap keyed by holder with the wave index as value, which the AI snapshot also reads (erDandelionBurstUsedWave); library time.once-per (wave scope) uses waveData.entryEffectsFired, a different memory, and adding a key there would change the AI state, so clause 2 stays in guards() and is listed as feasibility until the librarian adds a scope that can share a caller-owned memory (R-B15-7). Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) Cotton Spore is modelled as a Speed drop to EACH active foe (by design, documented in the source), (2) a foe's stat-stage phase is queued even when the Leech Seed tag was refused (Grass type), by design; (3) the once-per mark is written before any foe is acted on, so a holder whose foes all faint in the loop still uses it up.

None of the 14 has a constructor closure, so no binding is needed. The class has no condition or gate of its own and the trigger is separate, so nothing is hidden inside the package. It cannot be split because the library has none of the pieces: a moment 'before I use a move' that this class can hang on (event.before-i-use-move and event.my-move-starts exist, but they are dispatched by other attr classes and the form change is driven straight from MovePhase.start by constructor name), a table-driven form change (effect.change-form is not implemented and takes one fixed form key, not a per-type table), moveset replacement with per-form PP memory, the pinned ability and the revert on leaving; requested as R-B15-23 (effect 'change form by the type of the move I use, from a form table, with its own moves per form'). The effect 'use another stat in place of the attack stat' cannot be split because the library has no such effect and no moment for it: the engine picks the attack stat inside getBaseDamage by scanning the attacker's attrs by name, and nothing dispatches it, so the WHEN stays 'while active' until that seam is a moment. Requested as R-B15-36: the moment 'While the game picks the stat my attack uses', the condition 'I act before the target this turn' (time.acted-before, by the real turn order list) and the effect 'Use {stat} in place of the attack stat'; the same condition atom is what the defence half (RelativityDefenseReductionAbAttr) needs. The only setting is the stat, typed (constructor argument, default Speed). WHEN is 'while active' and needs RelativityAbAttr in that WHEN's flagKeys (added locally with this chunk, request R-B15-35, keep the union on merge). Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) the substitution runs after the move's own attack-stat change (VariableAtkAttr, the Foul Play style) and overwrites it, so Foul Play used by a Relativity holder that moved first hits with the holder's own Speed instead of the target's Attack; (2) it sits inside the same loop as the other attack-stat substitutes (Ancient Idol, Momentum), so a holder with two of them gets whichever attr comes LAST; (3) it is skipped while the attacker's ability is being ignored, and the order is compared per target, so one spread move can use Speed against one foe and Attack against the other.

blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified. 1 attr in 1 ability: Soulmate (5918 attr 0). The entry trigger is a separate swappable WHEN and the class has no condition, guard or gate (PostSummonAbAttr answers true). The effect is a soul link plus two engine reactions: the library has no 'link two Pokemon' effect (state in link.ts; the same missing block as Heartbreak, R-B15-13), no moment 'when my linked ally takes direct damage' with a 'take a share of it' effect (the same shape as Chivalry's R-B15-2, but through the link instead of the adjacent ally; R-B15-41) and no moment 'when I am healed' with a 'copy a share to my linked ally' effect (R-B15-42). Both shares are typed params read from the holder's live attr by the seams. Why it cannot be split further today: the link is one shared state with the two halves that read it (formLink in apply, getLinkedAlly in both seams), the seams are driven from Pokemon.damageAndUpdate and Pokemon.heal by constructor name, not from a dispatched moment, and a split would need the three library blocks above. Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) the redirect gate reads the link with getLinkedAlly(victim) and then asks the PARTNER for the marker, so the holder redirects damage only while it is itself ACTIVE and not fainted, and a holder that left the field stops sharing (intended); (2) the heal copy is computed from the ACTUAL amount healed, so overheal is not copied; (3) formLink skips allies that are already linked, so a holder next to an ally that Heartbreak linked first gets no link; (4) the recursion guard is a module variable shared by every holder, which is safe only because battle code is single threaded; the copied heal runs inside try/finally so the flag always resets.
